text:
* **Indoor Displays E5/F1 (Dead Kit)**
  * **Check Voltage Indoor to Outdoor whether is ok?**
    * **No** -> Check Main Supply / Check Wiring
    * **Yes** ->
      * **Check Wiring at outdoor Unit whether is ok?**
        * **No** -> 
          Check Wiring  
          *L wire = L wire*  
          *N wire = N wire*  
          *S wire = S wire*
        * **Yes** ->
          * **Check Fuse of OD PCB whether is ok?**
            * **No** -> 
              Replace Fuse  
              *(if continuity shows 0000)

text:
* **Indoor Displays E5/F1 (Dead Kit)**

  * **Check Bridge Rectifier whether is ok?**
    * **No:**
      * **Check Bridge;**
      * AC Volts : 220V *(inner terminals)*
      * DC Volts : 220/300V *(outer terminals)*
      * Continuity between DC points : 97.8K ±5%
    * **Yes:**
      * **Check IGBT whether is ok?**
        * **No:**
          * **Check IGBT**
          * DC Voltage : 310~313V
          * Check Continuity at Supply Out
        * **Yes:**
          * **Check OD Kit IPM whether is ok?**
            * **No:**
              * **Check IPM**
              * DC Volts at Supply In: 310~313V
